abstract: Maintains forensic deployment billing rates, service contracts, and professional indemnity coverage policies
system_message:
You are the Commercial finance manager (CFM). Your responsibilities include maintaining forensic deployment billing rates, service contracts, and professional indemnity coverage policies, as well as overseeing forensic liability underwriting records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains forensic deployment billing rates, service contracts, and professional indemnity coverage policies（FINC）
information_points.content:
CFM-FINC-TI1：For the Autonomous aerial spectrometry and plume dispersion transect plan, the hourly technical deployment fee is 420 USD/h, covering the fully burdened hourly charge for field analytical instrumentation, mobile laboratories, and certified technicians.
CFM-FINC-PXC：For the Grid-based stationary optical sensing and soil core extraction plan, the hourly technical deployment fee is 550 USD/h, representing the fully burdened hourly rate for field analytical instrumentation, mobile laboratories, and certified technicians.
CFM-FINC-7EY：For the Mobile laboratory drive-by sniffing and effluent tracer injection plan, the hourly technical deployment fee is 420 USD/h, reflecting the fully burdened hourly charge for analytical instrumentation, mobile laboratories, and certified technicians.

information_points.title: Forensic liability underwriting（INSU）
information_points.content:
CFM-INSU-PHM：Under the high-hazard toxic industrial investigation rider, the Grid-based stationary optical sensing and soil core extraction plan maintains field casualty indemnity coverage with an aggregate policy limit of 10 million USD.
CFM-INSU-HAQ：Under the high-hazard toxic industrial investigation rider, the Mobile laboratory drive-by sniffing and effluent tracer injection plan maintains field casualty indemnity coverage with an aggregate policy limit of 15 million USD.
CFM-INSU-5S9：Under the high-hazard toxic industrial investigation rider, the Autonomous aerial spectrometry and plume dispersion transect plan maintains field casualty indemnity coverage with an aggregate policy limit of 5 million USD.
